risks.note: Tables briefly readable without auth; closed by deny-all RLS.
Receipt-claim flow scoped per session to prevent cross-user reads.

findings.desc: The product: a posed decision runs a Claude pipeline and returns one bearing + a graded receipt.
0 human author; no external contributors; ADR-governed.
Canon is the substrate; running code is the thinnest executable slice of a written world.
ADR-023 goal lattice + load-tested Conductor sim; not yet wired to live receipts (gated).
Separate dev and prod databases, externalized.
Auth enforced at the app layer (ADR-001) rather than the data layer alone.
Row-level security deny-all across all Supabase tables.
Full request path from compass POST to rendered receipt.
Y-gate state drives render resolution (earned fidelity).
Env + secret rotation is manual; no automated alerting.
The compass route is 322 lines — the heaviest single handler.
ygate.ts is 248 lines and carries the core gate logic.
The pipeline is a single L0–L5 prose prompt, not orchestrated agents.
Structured arrays serialized to TEXT columns (SQLite-compat).
